host.name: AssemblyAI Speech Understanding
host.auth: Authorization header is the API key. Required on every request.

docs.statement: Generate summaries of your audio transcripts split into chapters with timestamps.

docs.function: action items with timestamp and quote
docs.statement: Generate action items of your audio transcripts w/ timestamps and a quote of where the action item is from.

docs.oneOf: speech_understanding.request is oneOf a single task. This adapter submits summarization and action items as two jobs.

commands.write: Submits the documented transcript jobs and writes minutes.json from the official JSON only.
commands.resume: Polls transcript ids already saved. Does not submit a new job.
commands.trace: Local lookup of mN start/end or aN timestamp and quote. No network.

unavailable: Missing ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY exits 2 with network not_sent. No minutes are invented.
